text.en: Brief verses on beauty, art and conduct.

Thirukkural, by Thiruvalluvar, has 1330 couplets in three parts: aram, porul and inbam. The selection here goes with the theme of arts and beauty.
Each kural has a precise meaning and is useful in everyday life.
Learn the kural's words, meaning and chapter name; practise explaining it in your own words.
